exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. (continued: 15-16)
exercises.explanationUz:
9-MAShQNING OXIRGI IKKI BANDI
(62-betdan davom etadi)


JAVOBLAR:
  15  my    →  ME
  16  these →  THOSE


15  'EXCUSE MY, what's the time?'
    → 'EXCUSE ME, what's the time?'

    'Excuse ME' — turg'un ibora.
    'me' — TO'LDIRUVCHI olmoshi
    ('excuse' fe'lining to'ldiruvchisi).
    'my' — EGALIK sifati, undan keyin OT
    kelishi kerak edi ('my book').

    Ma'nosi: 'Kechirasiz' (birovga murojaat
    qilishdan oldin).

    Shu kabi: 'Excuse me, where is the
    station?'


16  'There wasn't a cinema in THESE days.'
    → 'There wasn't a cinema in THOSE days.'

    THESE = bular (YAQIN, hozirgi)
    THOSE = ular (UZOQ, o'tgan)

    Gapda 'WASN'T' — O'TGAN zamon, demak
    uzoqdagi vaqt haqida → THOSE.

    'in those days' — turg'un ibora
    ('o'sha paytlarda').

    KO'RSATISh OLMOShLARI JADVALI:
       YAQIN         UZOQ
       this (birlik)  that (birlik)
       these (ko'plik) those (ko'plik)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Excuse me     = Kechirasiz
  in those days = o'sha paytlarda

commonMistake.whyUz:
'EXCUSE ME' — turg'un ibora.

'me' — TO'LDIRUVCHI olmoshi.
'my' — EGALIK sifati, undan keyin OT kerak:
  'my book' ✓ / 'excuse my' ✗

Ma'nosi: birovga murojaat qilishdan oldingi
odobli boshlanish.

items.sentence: 16  There wasn't a cinema in THESE days.

commonMistake.whyUz:
ZAMON KALITI: 'WASN'T' — O'TGAN zamon.

THESE = bular (YAQIN, hozirgi)
THOSE = ular (UZOQ, o'tgan)

O'tmish haqida gapirilyapti → THOSE.
'in those days' = o'sha paytlarda (turg'un
ibora).

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — AMAZON O'RMONI HAQIDA

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  THE      7  THE
   2  —        8  THE
   3  —        9  —
   4  THE     10  THE
   5  THE     11  THE
   6  THE     12  —

  Ya'ni: 'the' KERAK — 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11
         'the' KERAK EMAS — 2, 3, 9, 12


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

  THE Amazon Rainforest is in — Brazil,
  — South America. It lies at the beginning of
  THE Amazon River. THE Amazon River is THE
  longest river in the world.

  THE Amazon Rainforest is a very beautiful
  place. A lot of animals, birds and insects
  live in it. There are also many trees and
  plants.

  THE forest has a serious problem. People are
  cutting down too many of its trees. As a
  result, many of its plants and animals are
  dying. — Trees and plants are very important
  to the environment. Scientists say that THE
  world is in danger because of THE destruction
  of — rainforests.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Amazon tropik o'rmoni Braziliyada, Janubiy
  Amerikada joylashgan. U Amazonka daryosining
  boshlanish qismida yotadi. Amazonka —
  dunyodagi eng uzun daryo.

  Amazon o'rmoni juda go'zal joy. Unda ko'plab
  hayvon, qush va hasharotlar yashaydi. Yana
  ko'p daraxt va o'simliklar bor.

  O'rmonning jiddiy muammosi bor. Odamlar uning
  juda ko'p daraxtini kesyapti. Natijada uning
  ko'plab o'simlik va hayvonlari nobud
  bo'lmoqda. Daraxt va o'simliklar atrof-muhit
  uchun juda muhim. Olimlar aytishicha, tropik
  o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli dunyo
  xavf ostida.


'THE' QO'YILADIGAN HOLLAR (bu matndan):

  1) O'RMON, DARYO, DENGIZ, OKEAN nomlari:
        THE Amazon Rainforest  (1, 7)
        THE Amazon River       (4, 5)
        the Atlantic Ocean, the Nile

  2) USTUN DARAJA:
        THE longest river      (6)
        the best, the biggest

  3) ALLAQAChON AYTILGAN narsa:
        THE forest             (8)
        (yuqorida 'Amazon Rainforest' deyilgan
         edi — endi 'o'sha o'rmon')

  4) YAGONA narsalar:
        THE world              (10)
        the sun, the moon, the sky

  5) 'THE ... OF ...' qurilmasi:
        THE destruction OF rainforests  (11)
        the top of the hill


'THE' QO'YILMAYDIGAN HOLLAR (bu matndan):

  1) MAMLAKAT nomlari:
        — Brazil               (2)
        (ISTISNO: the USA, the UK,
         the Netherlands)

  2) QIT'A nomlari:
        — South America        (3)
        (— Europe, — Africa, — Asia)

  3) UMUMIY ma'nodagi KO'PLIK ot:
        — Trees and plants are important  (9)
        — rainforests          (12)
        (barcha daraxtlar, barcha o'rmonlar
         haqida — aniq emas)


ENG NOZIK JOY — 9 va 12:
  9   '— TREES and plants are very important'
      → BARCHA daraxtlar haqida (umumiy)
      → 'the' YO'Q

  12  'destruction of — RAINFORESTS'
      → BARCHA tropik o'rmonlar haqida
      → 'the' YO'Q

  LEKIN 8-bandda:
      'THE forest has a serious problem'
      → aynan AMAZON o'rmoni haqida (yuqorida
        aytilgan)
      → 'the' KERAK

  Ya'ni: UMUMIY → the yo'q;  ANIQ → the bor.


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT 14 MAVZUSI:
  Matn ATROF-MUHIT haqida — Coursebook
  98-103-betlar bilan bir mavzu.
  Yana: Coursebook 88-89-bet (The Expedition,
  2-epizod) ham tropik o'rmon haqida edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a rainforest    = tropik o'rmon
  to lie          = yotmoq, joylashgan bo'lmoq
  the beginning   = boshlanish
  an insect       = hasharot
  a plant         = o'simlik
  serious         = jiddiy
  to cut down     = kesib tashlamoq
  as a result     = natijada
  to die          = nobud bo'lmoq
  a scientist     = olim
  in danger       = xavf ostida
  destruction     = yo'q qilish, vayron qilish

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'RMON, DARYO, DENGIZ nomlari 'THE' oladi:
  THE Amazon Rainforest
  THE Nile, THE Pacific Ocean

MAMLAKAT nomlari 'the' OLMAYDI:
  — Brazil, — France, — Uzbekistan

ISTISNOLAR: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands
(ko'plik yoki birikma nomlar).

QIT'A nomlari 'the' OLMAYDI:
  — South America, — Europe, — Africa, — Asia

items.sentence: 4  It lies at the beginning of ...... Amazon River.
items.uz: U Amazonka daryosining boshlanish qismida yotadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
DARYO nomlari DOIM 'THE' oladi:
  THE Amazon River, THE Nile, THE Thames

'to LIE' = yotmoq, joylashgan bo'lmoq
(lie → LAY → LAIN).

Yana DARYO nomi → THE.
4-band bilan bir xil.

items.sentence: 6  ... is ...... longest river in the world.

commonMistake.whyUz:
USTUN DARAJA DOIM 'THE' oladi:
  THE longest, THE best, THE biggest

'-EST' qo'shimchasi 'the' ni talab qiladi.

items.sentence: 7  ...... Amazon Rainforest is a very beautiful place.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Yana O'RMON nomi → THE.
1-band bilan bir xil.

ALLAQACHON AYTILGAN narsa → THE.

Yuqorida 'the Amazon Rainforest' deyilgan edi,
endi 'O'SHA o'rmon' haqida gapirilyapti.

DIQQAT — 9 va 12 BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  8   ANIQ o'rmon  → THE
  12  UMUMIY o'rmonlar → the YO'Q

items.sentence: 9  ...... trees and plants are very important to the environment.
items.uz: Daraxt va o'simliklar atrof-muhit uchun juda muhim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
UMUMIY ma'nodagi KO'PLIK ot 'the' OLMAYDI.

Bu yerda BARCHA daraxtlar haqida gapirilyapti,
aniq bir daraxtlar haqida emas:
  'Trees are important.'  ✓ (umumiy)
  'THE trees in my garden are tall.' ✓ (aniq)

items.sentence: 10  Scientists say that ...... world is in danger

commonMistake.whyUz:
YAGONA narsalar DOIM 'THE' oladi:
  THE world, THE sun, THE moon, THE sky,
  THE earth

Dunyo bitta — shuning uchun 'the'.

'THE ... OF ...' qurilmasi:
  THE destruction OF rainforests
  THE top OF the hill
  THE beginning OF the river

'of' bilan aniqlangan ot 'the' oladi.

'BECAUSE OF + OT' — sabab (predlog).

UMUMIY ma'nodagi KO'PLIK ot → 'the' YO'Q.

Bu yerda BARCHA tropik o'rmonlar haqida
(dunyo bo'ylab), aniq bittasi haqida emas.

9-band bilan bir xil qoida.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the comparative or superlative forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyosiy yoki ustun daraja shakllarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  MORE BEAUTIFUL
   2  NOISIER
   3  OLDER ... THE OLDEST
   4  THE LARGEST
   5  MORE EXPENSIVE
   6  CLEVERER
   7  BIGGER
   8  TALLER ... THE TALLEST
   9  THE MOST LUXURIOUS
  10  QUIETER


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI SAVOL:

  1-SAVOL: QIYOSIY mi, USTUN mi?
     'THAN' bor  →  QIYOSIY  (-er / more)
     'OF ALL' yoki 'IN THE ...' bor
                 →  USTUN    (the -est / the most)

  2-SAVOL: SIFAT UZUNMI?
     1 bo'g'in yoki -y bilan tugasa
                 →  -ER / -EST
     2+ bo'g'in   →  MORE / THE MOST


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  beautiful (3 bo'g'in) + 'than'
    → MORE BEAUTIFUL than

 2  noisy (-y bilan tugaydi) + 'than'
    → y → I + ER = NOISIER than

 3  IKKI BO'SHLIQ:
    'old ... THAN'      → OLDER (qiyosiy)
    'old ... OF ALL'    → THE OLDEST (ustun)

 4  'large ... IN THE WORLD' → ustun
    'large' oxirida 'e' bor → faqat -ST
    → THE LARGEST

 5  expensive (3 bo'g'in) + 'than'
    → MORE EXPENSIVE than

 6  clever (2 bo'g'in, lekin -er bilan tugaydi)
    + 'than'
    → CLEVERER than
    (Ba'zi kitoblarda 'MORE CLEVER' ham qabul
     qilinadi — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin
     'cleverer' ko'proq ishlatiladi.)

 7  big (1 bo'g'in, unli+undosh) + 'than'
    → G IKKILANADI: BIGGER than

 8  IKKI BO'SHLIQ:
    'tall ... THAN'     → TALLER (qiyosiy)
    'tall ... OF ALL'   → THE TALLEST (ustun)

 9  luxurious (4 bo'g'in) + 'IN THE AREA'
    → ustun, uzun sifat
    → THE MOST LUXURIOUS

10  quiet (2 bo'g'in) + 'much ... THAN'
    → QUIETER than
    ('much' — qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi:
     'much quieter' = ancha tinchroq)


YASALISh QOIDALARI — TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  1 BO'G'IN:
     tall  → tallER  → the tallEST
     old   → oldER   → the oldEST

  1 BO'G'IN, oxiri UNLI+UNDOSh:
     big   → bigGER  → the bigGEST
     hot   → hotTER  → the hotTEST
     (oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI)

  Oxiri 'E' bilan:
     large → largER  → the largEST
     nice  → nicER   → the nicEST
     (faqat -R / -ST qo'shiladi)

  Oxiri 'Y' bilan:
     noisy → noisIER → the noisIEST
     easy  → easIER  → the easIEST
     (y → I + ER/EST)

  2+ BO'G'IN:
     beautiful → MORE beautiful
               → THE MOST beautiful
     expensive → MORE expensive
               → THE MOST expensive

  NOTO'G'RI ShAKLLAR:
     good  → better → the best
     bad   → worse  → the worst
     far   → further → the furthest


DIQQAT — USTUN DARAJADA 'THE' ShART:
     'the oldest of all'   ✓
     'oldest of all'       ✗


DIQQAT — QIYOSIYDA 'THAN' ShART:
     'older THAN the Colosseum'  ✓
     'older AS the Colosseum'    ✗
     (62-betdagi 9-mashqning 5-bandi!)


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'THAN ME':
  'My sister is cleverer THAN ME.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'than me' ✓
  Rasmiy yozuvda 'than I am' ✓
  ('than I' — juda rasmiy)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  noisy      = shovqinli
  a motorbike = mototsikl
  the Parthenon = Parfenon (Afinadagi ibodatxona)
  the Colosseum = Kolizey (Rimdagi amfiteatr)
  the Pyramids  = Piramidalar (Misr)
  a desert   = sahro
  clever     = aqlli
  a neighbour = qo'shni
  luxurious  = hashamatli
  an area    = hudud
  the country = qishloq (bu ma'noda)
  quiet      = tinch

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'beautiful' — 3 bo'g'in (UZUN sifat)
→ MORE + sifat.

'beautifuller' XATO!

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'noisy' oxiri 'Y' → Y ni I ga aylantirib + ER:
  noisy → noisIER

'more noisy' — kam ishlatiladi.
'than MINE' = 'than my motorbike'.

items.sentence: 3a  The Parthenon is ................. (old) than the Colosseum,

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → -ER:
  old → oldER

Tarixiy haqiqat: Parfenon (mil. avv. 447-438)
Kolizeydan (mil. 70-80) ancha qadimiy.

items.sentence: 3b  ... but the Pyramids are .................. (old) of all.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'OF ALL' bor → USTUN daraja.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → THE + -EST:
  the oldEST

'THE' SHART! ('oldest of all' — xato)

Tarixiy haqiqat: Misr piramidalari
(mil. avv. 2600 yillar) — eng qadimiy.

items.sentence: 4  Which is .......................... (large) desert in the world?

commonMistake.whyUz:
'IN THE WORLD' bor → USTUN daraja.
'large' oxiri 'E' → faqat -ST qo'shiladi:
  large → the largEST

'largeest' XATO.

items.sentence: 5  Taxis in London are ..................... (expensive) than taxis in Rome.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in (UZUN) → MORE + sifat.

'expensiver' XATO!

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'clever' — 2 bo'g'in, lekin '-er' bilan
tugagani uchun -ER qo'shiladi:
  clever → cleverER

('MORE CLEVER' ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi,
 lekin 'cleverer' ko'proq ishlatiladi.)

'than ME' — og'zaki nutqda to'g'ri;
rasmiy: 'than I am'.

items.sentence: 7  Our neighbour's house is .................. (big) than ours.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'big' — 1 bo'g'in, oxiri UNLI+UNDOSH
→ oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI:
  big → bigGER

Shu kabi: hot → hotter, thin → thinner.

'than OURS' = 'than our house'.

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'tall' — 1 bo'g'in → tallER.

'OF ALL' bor → USTUN daraja.
'tall' — 1 bo'g'in → THE tallEST.

'THE' SHART!
3-band bilan bir xil naqsh (qiyosiy + ustun).

items.sentence: 9  The Grand is ....................... (luxurious) hotel in the area.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'IN THE AREA' bor → USTUN daraja.
'luxurious' — 4 bo'g'in (UZUN)
→ THE MOST + sifat.

'the luxuriousest' XATO!

'The Grand' — mehmonxona nomi.

items.sentence: 10  I want to live in the country. It's much ....................... (quiet) than the city.
items.uz: Qishloqda yashashni xohlayman. U shahardan ancha tinchroq.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY.
'quiet' — 2 bo'g'in, lekin qisqa sifat sifatida
-ER oladi:
  quiet → quietER

DIQQAT — 'MUCH':
'MUCH quieter' = ANCHA tinchroq.
'much' qiyosiy darajani KUCHAYTIRADI
(a lot, far ham shunday).

'the country' bu yerda = QISHLOQ (shahar
emas).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B (Can)
   2  A (Don't)
   3  C (is cooking)
   4  B (a)
   5  A (but)
   6  A (Can)
   7  C (Who)
   8  B (on)
   9  C (drives)
  10  A (do)


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  '... I have a glass of water, PLEASE?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.
    'Must I have ...?' = 'ichishim shartmi?'
    'Should I have ...?' = 'ichishim kerakmi?'
    → B (Can)
    (62-betdagi 9-mashqning 14-bandi ham shu
     gap edi!)

 2  '... drop litter in the street.'
    KALIT: gapda EGA YO'Q!
    'Shouldn't' va 'Mustn't' dan oldin EGA
    kerak ('You shouldn't ...').
    Egasiz ishlatiladigan yagona shakl —
    BUYRUQ MAYLI: 'DON'T'.
    → A (Don't)

 3  'He ... dinner AT THE MOMENT.'
    KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' = ayni damda
    → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → C (is cooking)

 4  'There is ... MAN at the door.'
    'man' — undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi
    → 'A'.
    'an' faqat UNLI tovush oldidan.
    'the' — aniq odam haqida bo'lardi, lekin
    'There is' YANGI narsani tanishtiradi.
    → B (a)

 5  'I did the shopping yesterday, ... I didn't
     clean the house.'
    KALIT: ikki qism QARAMA-QARShI
    (bir ishni qildim, ikkinchisini qilmadim).
    → A (but)

 6  '... I use your pen?'
    Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.
    'Can't I ...?' va 'Mustn't I ...?' —
    savol sifatida g'alati.
    → A (Can)

 7  '... did you go on holiday WITH?'
    KALIT: 'WITH' — kim BILAN?
    Odam haqida so'ralganda → WHO.
    'Which' — tanlov ichidan;
    'When' — vaqt.
    → C (Who)

 8  'take the first turning ... your left.'
    'ON your left/right' — turg'un ibora.
    → B (on)

 9  'He ... to work EVERY DAY.'
    KALIT: 'EVERY DAY' — takrorlanuvchi harakat
    → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    'He' — III shaxs birlik → -S qo'shiladi.
    → C (drives)

10  'Do they live in a flat?' 'Yes, they ...'
    QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
    takrorlaydi:
       'DO they ...?' → 'Yes, they DO.'
    'does' — 'he/she/it' uchun;
    'don't' — savolga ZID (Yes deyilgan).
    → A (do)


MASHQNING UCh ASOSIY KALITI:

  A) VAQT IBORASI zamonni belgilaydi:
        'at the moment' → Present Continuous (3)
        'every day'     → Present Simple (9)
        'yesterday'     → Past Simple (5)

  B) QISQA JAVOB savolni takrorlaydi (10)

  C) TURG'UN IBORALAR:
        'on your left' (8)
        'Can I ... please?' (1, 6)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv
  to drop litter   = axlat tashlamoq
  at the moment    = ayni damda
  to do the shopping = xarid qilmoq
  a turning        = burilish (yo'lda)
  on your left     = chap tomoningizda
  to go along      = ... bo'ylab bormoq
  a flat           = kvartira

items.textEn: 1  ................. I have a glass of water, please?  A Must  B Can  C Should
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat emas.
Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.

'Must I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz.

Grammar 61-bet, 4-mashqning 5-bandi ham
aynan shu gap edi.

items.textEn: 2  ................. drop litter in the street.  A Don't  B Shouldn't  C Mustn't
items.whyUz:
ENG MUHIM KALIT: gapda EGA YO'Q!

'Shouldn't' va 'Mustn't' dan OLDIN ega kerak:
  'YOU shouldn't drop litter.' ✓
  'Shouldn't drop litter.'     ✗

Egasiz ishlatiladigan yagona shakl —
BUYRUQ MAYLI: 'DON'T + fe'l'.

Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa:
'Do not drop rubbish in the street.'

items.textEn: 3  He ................. dinner at the moment.  A cooks  B cooked  C is cooking
items.uz: U ayni damda kechki ovqat pishiryapti.
items.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'AT THE MOMENT' = ayni damda
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS (is/are + -ing).

'cooks' — Present Simple (odat, har kuni)
'cooked' — Past Simple (o'tgan zamon)

Bu ikkalasi 'at the moment' bilan mos kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 4  There is ................. man at the door.  A an  B a  C the
items.whyUz:
'man' UNDOSH tovush /m/ bilan boshlanadi → 'A'.
'an' faqat UNLI tovush oldidan
(an apple, an hour).

'the' bo'lmaydi, chunki 'There is ...'
YANGI, noma'lum narsani tanishtiradi.

items.textEn: 5  I did the shopping yesterday, ................. I didn't clean the house.  A but  B to  C when
items.uz: Kecha xarid qildim, lekin uyni tozalamadim.
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ KALITI: ikki qism QARAMA-QARSHI —
bir ishni qildim, ikkinchisini QILMADIM.

Qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi → BUT.

'to' — maqsad; 'when' — vaqt. Ikkalasi ham
bu yerda mos kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 6  ................. I use your pen?  A Can  B Can't  C Mustn't
items.whyUz:
Ruxsat SO'RASH → CAN I ...?

'Can't I use your pen?' — bu norozilik
ohangi ('nega foydalanolmayman?').
'Mustn't I ...?' — juda g'alati.

1-band bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 7  ................. did you go on holiday with?  A Which  B When  C Who
items.whyUz:
KALIT: gap oxiridagi 'WITH' — kim BILAN?

ODAM haqida so'ralganda → WHO.
  'Who did you go with?' ✓

'Which' — berilgan tanlov ichidan
  ('Which hotel did you stay at?')
'When' — vaqt ('When did you go?')

DIQQAT: predlog gap OXIRIDA qoladi —
og'zaki inglizchada odatiy hol.

items.textEn: 8  Go along High Street and take the first turning ................. your left.  A in  B on  C to
items.uz: High Street bo'ylab boring va chap tomondagi birinchi burilishga kiring.
items.whyUz:
'ON your left / ON your right' — TURG'UN
ibora (yo'l ko'rsatishda).

  'on your left'  ✓
  'in your left'  ✗
  'to your left'  — ba'zan ishlatiladi, lekin
                   'on' standart

'a turning' = burilish (yo'ldagi).
'go ALONG a street' = ko'cha bo'ylab bormoq.

items.textEn: 9  He ................. to work every day.  A is driving  B drove  C drives
items.uz: U har kuni ishga mashinada boradi.
items.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'EVERY DAY' — takrorlanuvchi,
odatiy harakat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'He' — III shaxs BIRLIK → fe'lga -S:
  he driveS ✓

'is driving' — ayni damdagi harakat
('at the moment' bilan ishlatilardi).
'drove' — o'tgan zamon.

items.textEn: 10  'Do they live in a flat?' 'Yes, they ................. .'  A do  B does  C don't
items.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi YORDAMCHI FE'LNI
takrorlaydi:
  'DO they live ...?' → 'Yes, they DO.'

'does' — faqat he/she/it uchun
  ('Does he live ...?' → 'Yes, he does.')

'don't' — 'YES' bilan ZID:
  'Yes, they don't' — mantiqsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: I like your new dress, Tina.
    B: Oh, thanks. I BOUGHT it yesterday.
    A: WAS it very expensive?
    B: Yes, it WAS.
    A: ARE YOU GOING TO WEAR it to the party
       tonight?
    B: Yes, I AM.

 2  A: Hi, Sue. It'S Anne. What ARE YOU DOING
       this evening?
    B: Oh, hello Anne. Well, I'M GOING TO STAY
       at home and relax.
    A: Okay. I'LL CALL you tomorrow.

 3  A: How WAS your holiday, Molly?
    B: Oh, it WAS terrible! The hotel WAS very
       expensive and the beach WAS dirty.
    A: What about the weather?
    B: It RAINED every day.
    A: WAS the food good?
    B: No, it TASTED awful!

 4  A: I'M hungry.
    B: What about a sandwich?
    A: No, thanks. I WANT something hot.
       I think I'LL HAVE a bowl of soup.

 5  A: There WAS a great film on TV yesterday.
       DID YOU SEE it?
    B: No, I DIDN'T.


ZAMONLAR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  PAST SIMPLE — 'yesterday', tugagan voqea
     bought, was, rained, tasted, did you see,
     didn't

  PRESENT SIMPLE — hozirgi holat, his-tuyg'u
     it's (Anne), I'm (hungry), I want

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ayni damda
     What are you doing (this evening)?

  BE GOING TO — REJA (oldindan o'ylangan)
     Are you going to wear ...?
     I'm going to stay at home

  WILL — AYNI DAMDAGI qaror
     I'll call you tomorrow
     I think I'll have a bowl of soup


1-DIALOG BATAFSIL:

  'I BOUGHT it yesterday' — 'YESTERDAY' →
     Past Simple. buy → BOUGHT.

  'WAS it very expensive?' — o'tmishdagi
     narx haqida → Past Simple.

  'Yes, it WAS.' — qisqa javob savolni
     takrorlaydi.

  'ARE YOU GOING TO WEAR it tonight?'
     ENG MUHIM KALIT: keyingi javob
     'Yes, I AM' — ya'ni javobda 'BE' fe'li!
     Demak savol ham 'BE' bilan boshlanishi
     kerak → 'ARE you going to wear'.
     ('Will you wear ...?' bo'lsa javob
      'Yes, I WILL' bo'lardi.)

  'Yes, I AM.' — 'Are you going to ...?' ga
     qisqa javob.


2-DIALOG BATAFSIL:

  'It'S Anne.' — telefonda o'zini tanishtirish
     turg'un shakli. ('It's + ism')

  'What ARE YOU DOING this evening?'
     Kelajakdagi reja haqida so'rash —
     Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

  'I'M GOING TO STAY at home' — REJA
     ('I'm staying' ham to'g'ri).

  'I'LL CALL you tomorrow' — AYNI DAMDA
     qabul qilingan qaror → WILL.
     ('Okay' so'zi qarorning hozir
      qabul qilinganini ko'rsatadi.)


3-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  Butun dialog TUGAGAN ta'til haqida →
  hammasi PAST SIMPLE:
     How WAS your holiday?
     it WAS terrible
     The hotel WAS expensive
     the beach WAS dirty
     It RAINED every day
     WAS the food good?
     it TASTED awful

  DIQQAT: 'every day' bo'lsa ham Past Simple —
  chunki ta'til TUGAGAN ('It rained every day'
  = o'sha ta'tilda har kuni yog'di).


4-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  'I'M hungry' — hozirgi holat → Present Simple.
  'I WANT something hot' — his/xohish →
     Present Simple ('I am wanting' XATO!).
  'I THINK I'LL HAVE a bowl of soup' —
     'I think' + WILL = ayni damdagi qaror.

  DIQQAT — 'WANT' DAVOM ETMAYDI:
     Xohish, his, fikr bildiruvchi fe'llar
     Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi:
        want, like, love, hate, know,
        understand, believe, need
     'I am wanting' ✗


5-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  'There WAS a great film on TV YESTERDAY'
     → Past Simple ('there is' ning o'tgan
       zamoni).
  'DID YOU SEE it?' → Past Simple savoli
     (did + ASOSIY shakl).
  'No, I DIDN'T.' → qisqa javob.

  DIQQAT: 'Did you SAW it?' XATO —
  'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dress     = ko'ylak
  to wear     = kiymoq (wear → WORE)
  to relax    = dam olmoq
  terrible    = dahshatli
  dirty       = iflos
  to taste    = ta'mi bo'lmoq
  awful       = juda yomon
  hungry      = och
  a sandwich  = buterbrod
  a bowl of soup = bir kosa sho'rva

items.sentence: 1a  B: Oh, thanks. I ................ (buy) it yesterday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'I have bought' bo'lmaydi — 'yesterday' aniq
o'tgan vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

Kecha sotib olingan — o'tmishdagi narx haqida
→ PAST SIMPLE.
'it' → WAS (was/were dan 'was').

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi fe'lni takrorlaydi:
  'WAS it expensive?' → 'Yes, it WAS.'

items.sentence: 1d  A: ................ (you/wear) it to the party tonight?

commonMistake.whyUz:
ENG MUHIM KALIT — KEYINGI JAVOBGA QARANG:
'Yes, I ...... (BE)' — javobda 'BE' fe'li!

Demak savol ham 'BE' bilan boshlanishi kerak:
  'ARE you going to wear ...?' → 'Yes, I AM.'

Agar 'WILL you wear ...?' bo'lsa, javob
'Yes, I WILL' bo'lardi — lekin kitob (be)
bergan.

'be going to' — oldindan o'ylangan REJA.

'ARE you going to ...?' ga qisqa javob:
'Yes, I AM.'

Qisqa javobda faqat 'be' qoladi
('Yes, I am going to wear it' — ortiqcha).

TELEFONDA o'zini tanishtirish turg'un shakli:
  'It's Anne.' = Bu Enn (gapiryapti).

PRESENT SIMPLE ('is' → qisqartma "'s").

DIQQAT: 'I am Anne' emas, 'IT'S Anne' —
telefonda shunday deyiladi.

KELAJAKDAGI REJA haqida so'rash →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'this evening' — yaqin kelajak, reja
allaqachon bor.

Unit 13 dan: aniq vaqt + reja → Present
Continuous.

items.sentence: 2c  B: Well, I ........................ (stay) at home and relax.

commonMistake.whyUz:
REJA (oldindan o'ylangan) → BE GOING TO.

('I'm staying at home' — Present Continuous
ham to'g'ri, chunki reja aniq.)

Unit 13 dan: 'be going to' — niyat/reja.

KALIT: 'OKAY' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilinyapti (Syuning javobini eshitgandan
keyin) → WILL.

'I'm going to call' bo'lsa — reja oldindan
bor edi degan ma'no chiqadi, lekin bu yerda
qaror hozir tug'ildi.

Unit 13 dan: WILL — ayni damdagi qaror.

Ta'til TUGAGAN → PAST SIMPLE.
'your holiday' — birlik → WAS.

PAST SIMPLE — tugagan ta'til haqida.
'terrible' = dahshatli.
PAST SIMPLE. 'The hotel' — birlik → WAS.
PAST SIMPLE. 'the beach' — birlik → WAS.

PAST SIMPLE — ta'til tugagan.

DIQQAT: 'EVERY DAY' bo'lsa ham Past Simple!
Chunki gap O'SHA ta'tildagi har kun haqida,
hozirgi odat haqida emas.

'to rain' — to'g'ri fe'l: rain → RAINED.
Ob-havo egasi DOIM 'IT'.

PAST SIMPLE savoli.
'food' — SANALMAYDIGAN → birlik → WAS.

PAST SIMPLE. taste → TASTED (to'g'ri fe'l).

DIQQAT: 'taste + SIFAT' (awful), RAVISH emas:
  'It tasted AWFUL.'   ✓
  'It tasted AWFULLY.' ✗

'taste' — his fe'li (look, smell, sound,
feel bilan bir guruh).

HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'I am hungry' → qisqartmasi "I'm".

DIQQAT: o'zbekchada 'qornim och' desak ham,
inglizchada 'I AM hungry' (to be bilan).

items.sentence: 4b  A: No, thanks. I ............ (want) something hot.

commonMistake.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — xohish bildiryapti.

DIQQAT — 'WANT' CONTINUOUS BO'LMAYDI:
  'I want' ✓
  'I am wanting' ✗

Shu kabi fe'llar: like, love, hate, know,
understand, believe, need — bularning
hammasi Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

items.sentence: 4c  I think I ..................... (have) a bowl of soup.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'I THINK' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilinyapti → WILL.

'I think I'll ...' — juda keng tarqalgan
qolip (hozirgi qaror).

Unit 13 dan: WILL — ayni damdagi qaror.
'have' bu yerda = yemoq/ichmoq.

items.sentence: 5a  A: There ................ (be) a great film on TV yesterday.
items.uz: Kecha televizorda ajoyib film bor edi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
'There is' ning o'tgan zamoni — 'There WAS'
(birlik: 'a film').

Ko'plik bo'lsa: 'There WERE two films'.

PAST SIMPLE savoli: DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl.

  'Did you SEE it?'  ✓
  'Did you SAW it?'  ✗ (did dan keyin ASOSIY
                        shakl!)

see → SAW → SEEN, lekin savolda 'see' qoladi.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
takrorlaydi:
  'DID you see it?' → 'No, I DIDN'T.'

Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 63-bet — 1-14 unitlar takrori: artikl, daraja, zamon.

patterns.exampleEn: Claire is more beautiful than Marie. Your motorbike is noisier than mine.
patterns.exampleUz: Kler Maridan chiroyliroq. Mototsikilingiz menikidan shovqinliroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — 'THAN' SHART.
Qisqa sifat → -ER; uzun sifat → MORE.

patterns.formula: THE + [sifat]+EST / THE MOST + [sifat] + OF ALL / IN THE ... .
patterns.exampleEn: The Pyramids are the oldest of all. The Grand is the most luxurious hotel in the area.
patterns.exampleUz: Piramidalar hammasidan qadimiy. Grand — hududdagi eng hashamatli mehmonxona.
patterns.explanationUz:
USTUN daraja — 'THE' SHART.
'of all' yoki 'in the ...' bilan keladi.

patterns.formula: THERE WAS / WERE + [ot] + [o'tgan vaqt].  —  DID you [fe'l]?  —  No, I DIDN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: There was a great film on TV yesterday. Did you see it? — No, I didn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha televizorda ajoyib film bor edi. Ko'rdingizmi? — Yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz:
Past Simple savolida 'DID + ASOSIY shakl'.
'Did you saw' — XATO.

patterns.formula: ARE YOU GOING TO + [fe'l] ... ?  —  Yes, I AM.
patterns.exampleEn: Are you going to wear it to the party tonight? — Yes, I am.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun bazmga uni kiyasizmi? — Ha, kiyaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
REJA — 'be going to'.
Qisqa javobda faqat 'be' qoladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I think I'll have a bowl of soup. Okay. I'll call you tomorrow.
patterns.exampleUz: O'ylaymanki, bir kosa sho'rva ichaman. Yaxshi. Ertaga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
AYNI DAMDAGI qaror → WILL.
'I think I'll ...' — juda keng tarqalgan qolip.

patterns.formula: DO they + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, they DO.   /   'Do I have to ...?' — 'Yes, you do.'
patterns.exampleEn: Do they live in a flat? — Yes, they do.
patterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
takrorlaydi.
